props.heading: What we make
props.intro: Four disciplines under one roof, so the logo, the box, the website and the launch film look like they came from the same place.

items.title: Brand identity
items.text: Naming, logo, type, colour and the guidelines your team will actually open.

items.text: Structure and graphics, printed and checked on press in Kathmandu or Delhi.

items.text: Designed and built by us, fast on a phone in Surkhet, easy for you to update.

pages.title: Studio
pages.seoDescription: Nine designers, developers and filmmakers above a bakery in Jhamsikhel. How we started and who we are.

props.title: Nine people and one long table in Jhamsikhel
props.text: Named after the stone resting platforms under Nepal’s pipal trees, where people stop, talk and carry on. That is what we want our work to be for our clients’ customers.

image.alt: The team gathered around printed work

props.eyebrow: Above the bakery on Jhamsikhel Road

props.heading: How it started
props.body:
Rojina left an agency job in 2074 with one client, a tea estate in Ilam that wanted to stop selling to middlemen. The tin we designed for them is still on the shelf.

Since then we have grown slowly, on purpose. Nine people is enough to do everything well and small enough that the person you meet is the person who does the work.
